;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Caracas drone explosions]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuela President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] survives what he claims is an assassination attempt involving drones while speaking at a military event in [[Caracas]]. Eight people are injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45073385 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents 
*An [[MI-8 helicopter]] belonging to [[Russia]]n company [[Utair]] crashes in [[Siberia]], killing 18 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45068113 (BBC)]

;Health and environment
*[[England|England's]] [[Local Government Association]] reports that approximately two-thirds of plastic objects which reach recycling facilities cannot be recycled, due to the mix of [[polymers]] used by producers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45058971 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[2017–18 North Korea crisis]]
**A report commissioned by the [[United Nations Security Council]] concludes that [[North Korea]] has not stopped its nuclear program and that it attempted to sell military supplies to [[Libya]], [[Sudan]] and [[Yemen]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45067681 (BBC)]
**[[Ri Yong-ho (diplomat)|Ri Yong-ho]], the [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (North Korea)|Minister of Foreign Affairs of North Korea]], says that his country will not start [[Nuclear disarmament|denuclearizing]] unless the [[United States]] takes reciprocal actions. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/04/world/asia/north-korea-us-nuclear-deal.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Colombia–Venezuela relations]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]] blames an [[Caracas drone explosions|alleged assassination attempt]] on [[Colombia]] and Venezuelan exiles in the [[United States|U.S.]] state of [[Florida]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/04/nicolas-maduros-speech-cut-short-while-soldiers-scatter (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Bangladesh road safety protests]]
**Nationwide student protests following the deaths of two teenagers killed by a speeding bus enter their fifth day, causing the government to shut down thousands of high schools. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/03/teenagers-bring-parts-of-bangladesh-to-a-halt-with-bus-death-protests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 United States gun violence protests]]
**Advocates of stricter gun control measures protest outside the [[National Rifle Association|NRA]] headquarters in [[Northern Virginia]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/national-march-on-the-nra-protest-nra-headquarters-fairfax-virginia-today-2018-08-04/ (CBS News)]

;Sports
*[[Oakland Raiders]] cornerback [[Daryl Worley]] is sentenced to three days in jail and two years of probation in June after pleading guilty to firearms and resisting arrest charges stemming from an incident in April.
